UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile holding scholar details, academic stage, and study metrics.

uid.description: Unique identifier corresponding to Firebase Auth UID.

academicStage.description: Academic stage such as 1L First-Year Scholar or Pre-Law Scholar.

studyStreak.description: Current consecutive study streak in days.

UserCourseProgress.title: UserCourseProgress
UserCourseProgress.description: Tracks student completion and progress for a specific course module.

userId.description: The UID of the student owning this course progress.

courseId.description: The unique course code identifier (e.g. CIV-101, CRIM-101).

completedLessons.description: Number of lessons completed in this module.

totalLessons.description: Total lessons available in this module.

nextTopic.description: Next recommended topic or article to study.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this course progress was last updated.

UserActivity.title: UserActivity
UserActivity.description: Log of recent study events, drills, or case completions.

userId.description: The UID of the student owning this activity record.

title.description: Title of the completed activity or drill.

meta.description: Additional context or score for the activity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the activity was logged.

UserBrief.title: UserBrief
UserBrief.description: Case brief note created by the student using FIRAC method.

userId.description: The UID of the student who authored the brief.

caseTitle.description: Title and citation of the case.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the brief was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the brief was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Primary user profile document containing student information.

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Logs of user activities and completions.

/users/{userId}/briefs/{briefId}.description: Student case briefs and FIRAC outlines.
